summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held June 8, 2026. The board elected Ms. Magda Maria de Regina Chambriard as Chairperson and Mr. Hélio Baptista Novaes as Vice-Chairperson for a two-year term. Additionally, the board approved the early termination of current statutory officers and elected new officers nominated by shareholder FIP: Helcio Tokeshi as CEO, Carlos Brandão as CFO/Investor Relations Officer, and Luiz Rossato as Chief Legal Officer. The filing notes a shareholders agreement between FIP and Petrobras. No deal terms, price, or premium are stated. Watch for shareholder dynamics between FIP and Petrobras.
